html: <sherpa-toast data-status="success" data-heading="Saved" data-value="The record was saved." data-duration="0">
use: For short feedback after an action, such as Saved, that goes away by itself after 5 seconds by default; a static helper such as `SherpaToast.success()` adds one. For a message that stays on the page, use `sherpa-callout`.
